reasoningChain.evidence: I want to test whether the rescued complete priest improves the support role.
The current fourth slot is held by a herb militia that has supplied useful but modest healing.
The rescue explicitly unlocked Dawn-Prayer Priest as a complete support hero.
The priest can replace the militia in slot 4 before the next combat.
A same-role swap preserves warrior, ranger, and mage while isolating the new support as the main roster change.
The rescued priest will contribute at least 100 healing in the next combat.

hypothesis.problem: The rescued priest's practical support value is unknown.
hypothesis.cause: It is a complete priest hero replacing a militia support in the same role.
